text:
Anika Patel: kicking off a quick thread on the dev samples launch + webinar split test. want to align on messaging, benchmark angle, and how inbound leads should route. :wave:
Matt Chung: yes please — going to be tight timeline. what's our control vs experiment here?
Anika Patel: control = single webinar: 'Build with Redwood: reference apps + benchmarks' 45m. experiment = two 30m tracks running concurrently: (A) hands-on refapp walkthrough, (B) benchmark deep-dive + cost/latency tradeoffs. we want to see which drives more trial signups.
Sara Gomez: love that. for messaging, i'd focus A on "get started in 15m" CTA and B on "see production numbers" CTA. CTAs affect funnel significantly.
Ben Holloway: agree. for benchmarks we should surface a simple narrative: throughput (tokens/s), median p99 latency, and cost-per-token estimates. keep it snackable.
Anika Patel: sample benchmark blurb for slides: "Redwood Inference: 60–80ms median token latency on Llama-2-13B quantized; 3x cost reduction vs naive batching" — is that safe to claim?
Matt Chung: we need to back that with internal runbook numbers. i'll pull the 2 recent pipeline runs and share a gist later. don't cite exact numbers until ops approves.
devrel-bot: FYI — existing refapp repo has a bench report: https://git.redwood/devsamples/bench/latest (public preview link).
Sara Gomez: perfect — i'll craft two sample subject lines for the email/webinar listing:
Sara Gomez: 1) "Ship a reference app in 15 minutes — live demo" (track A).
Sara Gomez: 2) "Real-world LLM benchmarks: latency, cost, and tradeoffs" (track B).
Ben Holloway: routing: can we gate by the track selection on the signup form? i.e., send 'track=B' leads to pipeline stage 'benchmark-interest' in HubSpot, and 'track=A' to 'quickstart-nurture'.
Matt Chung: yes. add UTMs on the confirmation email + webhook: utm_medium=webinar&utm_campaign=devsamples_launch&utm_content=trackA|trackB
Anika Patel: suggested HubSpot mapping (simple): track=A -> list_id: 7321 -> workflow: devsamples_quickstart -> assign to SDR queue. track=B -> list_id: 7322 -> workflow: devsamples_bench_followup -> assign to ML-eng nurture.
Anika Patel: Ben/Matt — can you confirm the webhook payload keys we expect? example: `{
  "email": "...",
  "track": "A",
  "utm_campaign": "devsamples_launch",
  "source": "webinar"
}`
Ben Holloway: yep. we'll accept `track` as literal. also set `lead_score=lead_score+10` for track B in the intake flow so bench-interested leads get higher priority.
Sara Gomez: A/B measurement: primary metric = trial signups within 14 days. secondary = demo requests and docs page traffic.
Matt Chung: can we tag trial signups with `experiment=webinar_track_split_v1` so we can pivot in analytics?
Anika Patel: yes. add that to the post-click redirect. i'll draft the copy and event spec.
devrel-bot: deploy note: webinar landing template `webinar/devsamples-v1` will be live on staging at 11:30 PT.
Ben Holloway: next steps: Matt -> bench numbers + webhook schema by EOD. Sara -> two email variants + 3 CTAs by tomorrow morning. Anika -> landing + event spec + HubSpot mapping by EOD tomorrow. i'll follow up on the SDR assignment flow. :rocket:
Anika Patel: thanks all — if anyone wants to pair on the landing, ping me. otherwise i'll post the draft here when ready. :+1:
